answer: Sybil resistance arises because each bonded identity is separately accountable, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities incurs a quadratic penalty, O(k²), rather than k independent fines. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier and asymmetric capital depreciation amplify aggregate loss, rapidly exhausting the swarm’s escrow and making false identities uneconomic. A voyage from a raven’s jetty cannot evade common-control correlation.
